title: Two Sum
description: Given an array of integers nums and an integer target, return indices of the two numbers such that they add up to target. Assume exactly one solution exists, and you may not use the same element twice.

boilerplate.python:

def main():
    import sys
    data = sys.stdin.read().split()
    n = int(data[0]); target = int(data[1])
    nums = list(map(int, data[2:2+n]))
    sol = Solution()
    result = sol.twoSum(nums, target)
    print(' '.join(map(str, result)))

title: Shortest path in undirected graph with unit weights
description: Given an undirected graph of N vertices (0 to N-1) and M edges with unit weight, find the shortest path (number of edges) from source vertex 0 to every other vertex. If a vertex is unreachable, its distance is -1.

boilerplate.python:
from collections import deque

{{USER_CODE}}

def main():
    import sys
    data = sys.stdin.read().split()
    idx = 0
    N = int(data[idx]); idx+=1
    M = int(data[idx]); idx+=1
    edges = []
    for _ in range(M):
        a = int(data[idx]); idx+=1
        b = int(data[idx]); idx+=1
        edges.append([a,b])
    sol = Solution()
    dist = sol.shortestPath(edges, N, M)
    print(' '.join(map(str, dist)))

if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()
